shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone slab/pillar
animal figure(s) in profile clinging to or set on the surface
vertical human/anthropomorphic-form monolith or figure with limbs indicated
justification: Both are upright stone monuments bearing low-relief animal or figural imagery, and both include a creature rendered in profile against a flat surface, but that is essentially the extent of it. A shows a dense narrative panel of multiple elaborately costumed figures above a horizontal band of repeated square glyph-like signs and zigzag filler, whereas B shows a bare T-shaped pillar with a single small quadruped in relief on a shaft and no field of figures, banding or sign-like motifs.
